items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (n : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : ℕ

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_totalDegree
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (i : σ) : MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f ≤ f.totalDegree

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_X_self
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] (i : σ) : MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (MvPolynomial.X i) = 1

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_X_of_ne
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] {i j : σ} (h : i ≠ j) : MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (MvPolynomial.X j) = 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_def
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [DecidableEq σ] (n : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) : MvPolynomial.degreeOf n p = Multiset.count n p.degrees

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_X
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [DecidableEq σ] (i j : σ) [Nontrivial R] : MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (MvPolynomial.X j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_one
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (n : σ) : MvPolynomial.degreeOf n 1 = 0

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_zero
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] (n : σ) : MvPolynomial.degreeOf n 0 = 0
